gwalior-kanpur-2009.notes: Source 1 crawl: department website with pages of the 2001, 2003 and 2004 Kanpur contests, none of 2009. Source 3: the earlier reader counted 46 Honorable Mention rows; the table has 46 rows including its header, so 45 teams.

sources.evidence: The crawl is the IIT Kanpur CSE department site: its ACM ICPC pages are of the Kanpur site contests of 2001 to 2004, and none is about the 2009 Gwalior-Kanpur contest.
Table of 106 rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the title The 2009 ACM-ICPC Asia Gwalior-Kanpur Regional Contest.
Page titled ACM-ICPC Kanpur Site with a Final Result table of 10 ranked teams (Institute Name, Team Name, Rank) and an unranked Honorable Mention table of 45 teams.
7-page PDF of full statements headed Problem A : Arrangement through Problem G : Badness, matching the known problem titles.
